title: Introduce session-facade + StreamFactory and credential resilience across Py/TS/Go SDKs
author: Priya Kapoor
description:
Motivation: Customers building long-lived streaming integrations asked for simpler session lifecycle primitives (session creation, graceful teardown, heartbeat) and a compact StreamFactory that standardizes async-iterator/pullstream ergonomics across languages. This PR introduces a session-facade API plus a StreamFactory abstraction in the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, and hardens credential refresh/fallback logic under load. The goal is parity: same high-level ergonomics and configuration surface (session TTL, heartbeat, retry bundles) across the three SDKs while keeping backward-compatibility with existing streaming helpers.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds SessionFacade concept (Session.create, Session.close, Session.snapshot) to py/ts/go SDKs.
- Implements StreamFactory that produces a standardized pullstream/async-iterator with built-in cancel, checkpoint, and progress hooks.
- Reworks credential pipeline: introduces a CredentialOrchestra that coordinates primary refresh + fallback prefetch and exposes lightweight lease events for stream consumers.
- Normalizes retry presets and backoff profiles used by stream reads across SDKs (tuned for sustained heartbeat traffic).
- Adds tests, examples, docstrings, and a new examples/streaming/session-facade quickstart used by the docs site.
- Bumps TS SDK to v1.27.4, Go SDK to v1.9.3, Python SDK to v0.38.1 in interop manifests.

Review conversation (selected excerpts):
- Ava Martinez (review): "Nice cohesive API. Two blockers: 1) session snapshot shape — can we make it explicit which fields are stable across versions? 2) credential fallback timing: in stress runs tokens sometimes race and we see duplicate refreshes."
- Priya (author): "Thanks — addressed snapshot docstring and added a deterministic snapshot serializer; added a token-deduping thin-cache to CredentialOrchestra to avoid duplicate refresh under contention (see auth/dedupe_cache.go and python equivalent)."
- Liam O'Connor (review): "TS StreamFactory ergonomics look good, but the iterator close path didn't run on one of my manual tests (node v18). I've added a small fix — thanks.
Also: can we add a short migration note for users using legacy pullstream helpers?"
- Priya: "Added migration section to docs and a compat wrapper in ts 'legacyBridge' that logs a deprecation warning when used."

Performance notes:
- Under simulated 500 concurrent sessions with 1s heartbeat, average auth refresh latency decreased by ~12ms due to dedupe cache.
- StreamFactory introduced negligible overhead; end-to-end token-per-request cost unchanged.

Merge outcome: "merged via squash". Merge metadata: commit message consolidated, changelog entries curated.

Release notes (user-facing):
- Introduces SessionFacade and StreamFactory in Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs for simplified streaming session lifecycle management.
- CredentialOrchestra improves robustness for long-running streams by coordinating refresh and fallback prefetch; reduces duplicate refreshes under contention.
- SDK version bumps: TS -> v1.27.4, Go -> v1.9.3, Python -> v0.38.1.
- Migration helpers provided for legacy pullstream users; see docs/sdk/streaming/session-facade.md for details.
